# Gemeindewerke Pfäffikon ZH

Support for schedules provided by [Gemeindewerke Pfäffikon ZH](https://www.gwpzh.ch/kalender).

Source for Gemeindewerke Pfäffikon ZH, Switzerland.

## Configuration via configuration.yaml

```yaml
waste_collection_schedule:
  sources:
    - name: gwpzh_ch
      args:
        zone: ZONE
```

### Configuration Variables

**zone**  
*(string) (required)*

## Example

```yaml
waste_collection_schedule:
  sources:
    - name: gwpzh_ch
      args:
        zone: Sammelkreis 1
```

## How to get the source arguments

Select your Sammelkreis (collection district) on the waste calendar at https://www.gwpzh.ch/kalender. The districts are described there: Sammelkreis 1 is north of the railway line up to Hochstrasse 199, including Irgenhausen, Neuhof, Oberwil, Bussenhausen, Steinacker, Berg, Wallikon, Humbel, Hermatswil, Ravensbüel, Rick, Seiler, Schür and Sulzberg. Sammelkreis 2 is south of the railway line from Bahnhofstrasse/Hochstrasse/Pilatusstrasse towards Wetzikon, plus from Hochstrasse 200, Tumbelen, Bächliacher, Sitzbühl, Lierennagel, Unter- and Oberbalm and Auslikon. Sammelkreis 3 is south of the railway line from Bahnhofstrasse/Hochstrasse/Pilatusstrasse towards Fehraltorf, including Frohwies, Matten, Im Spitz, Büel, the Schanz and Witzberg industrial areas, Faichrüti and Ruetschberg. Altpapier, Karton and Sonderabfall are municipality-wide. The example address Wallikerstrasse 81 (Wallikon) is Sammelkreis 1.
